scope: Q8 starter shader-only balanced whole-model A/B on Intel Arc Pro B70; no competitor performance claim
limitations: This measures the same ZINC binary with exactly one shader replaced; it is not a llama.cpp comparison.
All four workloads retain identical complete content hashes and token counts across every warmup and measured A/B request.
The long-context starter request reaches a natural EOS before the shared maximum budget; it remains retained rather than promoted as a complete competitor comparison.
The mathematical proof uses the recorded prototype sources and compiler. The production CI archive still needs its own shader and all-model regression checks.
The Q4 candidate remains untested in whole-model inference because its proof requires SIMD32, which the production Q4 pipeline does not require.
This does not qualify startup, memory, streaming latency or an all-dimension win.
